collapsed.name: HUD collapsed
collapsed.hint: Remember whether the HUD is collapsed to its small tab.

scale.name: HUD scale
scale.hint: Scales the whole HUD. 1 is the default size.

hideMacroBar.name: Hide the macro bar while the HUD is open
hideMacroBar.hint: Hides Foundry's macro hotbar so the HUD can use the bottom of the screen.

alwaysHideMacroBar.name: Always hide the macro bar
alwaysHideMacroBar.hint: Hides Foundry's macro hotbar at all times, even while the HUD is collapsed or hidden.

showForGM.name: Show the HUD for the GM
showForGM.hint: The HUD appears for a GM only while a player character token is controlled.

showCombatBar.name: Show the combat bar
showCombatBar.hint: The bar above the HUD during combat with the round, whose turn it is, your action pips, initiative and End Turn. Turn it off if you prefer the system's combat tracker; the pips and End Turn are then only available there.

NIMBLE_HUD.wrongSystem: Nimble HUD requires the Nimble game system.
NIMBLE_HUD.pendingGain: Gains {count} additional action at the start of the next turn
NIMBLE_HUD.pendingGainPlural: Gains {count} additional actions at the start of the next turn
NIMBLE_HUD.pendingLoss: Starts the next turn with {count} fewer action
NIMBLE_HUD.pendingLossPlural: Starts the next turn with {count} fewer actions
NIMBLE_HUD.confirmEndTurnBody: You haven't used all your actions yet. Are you sure you want to end your turn?
NIMBLE_HUD.noPermissionInitiative: You do not have permission to roll initiative for this character.
NIMBLE_HUD.noPermissionEndTurn: Could not end the turn. A GM must be connected for players to end turns.
NIMBLE_HUD.quickBarEmpty: Drag an item or macro here
NIMBLE_HUD.quickBarForeignItem: Only items owned by this character can be placed on the quick bar.
NIMBLE_HUD.quickBarMacroImportFailed: The macro could not be imported from its compendium.

armorTooltip.medium: Medium Armor: Takes damage only from the rolled dice, ignoring all positive damage modifiers.
armorTooltip.heavy: Heavy Armor: Takes half damage (rounded up) from the dice, ignoring all positive damage modifiers.
